title: Health Behavior Interventions
description: This course focuses on critical analyses of health behavior theories and their applications to interventions in multiple fields, such as (but not limited to) nutrition, cancer, and physical activity. The course will prepare students to design, plan, implement, and evaluate health behavior interventions covering individual and population approaches to behavior change. Prerequisites: must be enrolled in MPH program (PB75 and PB87) or program approval and successfully completed PH 402. Renumbered from FMPH 410. Students may not receive credit for both FMPH 410 and PH 410.
